name: Mijas (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Mijas (a tower on red between olive branches with red flowers).
history: The symbols of Mijas are its flag and its arms; the flag was approved by the Junta de Andalucía on 24 January 2000 and is an oblong flag composed of three stripes parallel to each other and perpendicular to the hoist, the first green, the second white and the third blue. The arms were approved by resolution of 17 January 2012.
